messages:
maria: quick snapshot — Optimize toolkit delivery status. Two items: quant recs landed into staging but runtime kernel hasn't rolled, and canary for cache+batching shows a regression. Need owners/next steps. :warning:

sam: saw PR #5123, left comments on narrowing quant thresholds. kernel change in eng-runtime is the blocker for the staging test. :eyes:

kelsey: I can pick up the runtime toggles. which exact config are we planning to ship for the canary?

maria: config we were testing in staging (copy):
```
batching:
  max_batch_size: 16
  microbatch_window_ms: 12
  kv_cache: enabled
quant:
  algo: q4_0
  per_channel: true
  calibrate: fast
```
Note: this is the current staging blob.

mateo: FYI canary metrics vs baseline (10k requests): p95 latency +12%, throughput (tokens/s) -18%, error rate +0.02. eval harness flagged 32 prompts in `optkit-regress-v3`. Not catastrophic but noticeable.

priya: @mateo can you paste a couple failing prompt ids? We should decide whether to pause rollout. Also tagging SRE for canary gating.

deploy-bot: Canary paused — 2 health checks failed (p95 latency above threshold, regressed correctness for 32 prompts). See CI run: https://ci.internal/runs/5982

sam: suggestion: revert to `q4_1` fallback for families with >16k vocab and reduce microbatch_window_ms -> 8 to lower p95. That should give us a closer latency profile while we iterate on kernel.

kelsey: sounds reasonable. I'll author a targeted PR to add per-model toggles and a runtime flag for microbatch window. Will include a feature flag gate.

maria: I'll own the canary gating. Proposed gating thresholds: p95 increase <= 5% and error rate <= 0.1% absolute. Canary size = 1k requests. If criteria met, promote.

mateo: I can re-run the evals with the q4_1 fallback and reduced window. Running now, will post numbers in thread.

eng-ml-bot: eval job queued: optkit-regress-v3 (run 5991). ETA ~20m.

priya: timeline question — assuming runtime PR lands today and review completes, can we re-open canary tomorrow morning?

sam: I'll prioritize the runtime kernel review. If tests are green I can merge in next 3–4 hours. Ping me the PR link.

kelsey: opened PR #5160 — config toggles + tests, assigned to @sam. Link: https://git.internal/redwood/pulls/5160 :shipit:

mateo: quick results — q4_1 + microbatch=8ms: p95 delta down to +3%, throughput -6% (acceptable), flagged prompts reduced to 6. Posting raw numbers to CI.

maria: great — @sam can you review #5160 + the runtime kernel PR? If both green i'll re-run a 1k request canary tonight and gate on the thresholds.

sam: will do, prioritizing now.

kelsey: once merged i'll add a rollout plan in the console (canary -> 5% -> 20%). I'll also include a rollback playbook and the eval prompt set.

maria: thanks team. I'll update the delivery board and loop in customer-facing PMs about the slight delay.

mateo: placing a note — if we hit any embedding drift in the final eval we'll add an A/B with old quant for 50% traffic split before full promote.

priya: ack. keep me posted.

sam: quick ask — @maria drop the exact kernel PR link here so I can attach to my review.

maria: https://git.internal/redwood/eng-runtime/pulls/2387 (kernel + kernel selection tests).

kelsey: thanks. I'll also add a small smoke test to the canary config to validate KV cache hits.

maria: perfect. target: EOD tomorrow if no surprises. :thumbsup:

deploy-bot: Reminder: please tag incidents channel if canary triggers rollback.

sam: on it.

kelsey: PR #5160 assigned, will follow up on tests.

mateo: will post eval summary here when done.

maria: closing the loop for now — thanks everyone.
